Value: The study will require a total of 16 subjects to establish Noninferiority of the treatment group to the control group with desired power of 88.448%. This test is based on a 1-Sided ratio of means test for a 2x2 crossover design for continuous response data with significance level 0.027. The ratio of means between treatment and control groups under the alternative hypothesis is 0.77. This test assumes a Noninferiority margin of 0.4 and root mean squared error of the log ratio equal to 0.55. The allocation ratio is 1.2, and therefore of the 16 subjects, 7 are allocated to the control-treatment sequence and 9 subjects are allocated to the treatment-control sequence.
